errors.text_span: The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” ranges from 0 to 0.8 in linear increments, with major gridlines marked at intervals of 0.2.
errors.evidence: The y-axis actually extends to 1.0 with tick marks up to 0.9/1.0, not just 0.8.

errors.text_span: The “Single-task_baseline” model shows the lowest performance across all tasks
errors.evidence: Single-task_baseline is not the lowest on all tasks; its Paraphrase Accuracy is higher than the Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout bar (about 0.79 vs. 0.78).

errors.text_span: The “Supervised_SimCSE” model achieves the highest scores across all tasks
errors.evidence: Supervised_SimCSE does not have the highest scores across all tasks: its Sentiment Accuracy (~0.49) is lower than several other models, and its Paraphrase Accuracy (~0.78) is not higher than the Single-task_baseline (~0.79).

errors.text_span: The “2-Tier SimCSE” model achieves the highest scores across all tasks
errors.evidence: 2-Tier SimCSE does not have the highest scores across all tasks: its Sentiment Accuracy (~0.49) is lower than the Single-task_baseline (~0.53), and its Paraphrase Accuracy (~0.78) is below the Single-task_baseline (~0.79).
The description omits that the bars are grouped by model in sets of three and that a legend is shown at the top; while the legend is mentioned, the top placement is not.
